exposure: isolated rectovaginal septum injury during spontaneous vaginal delivery
cohort: The study analyzed the records of women who had spontaneous vaginal deliveries resulting in live births at a single center between January 2015 and January 2020.
finding: Isolated rectovaginal septum injuries are rare (0.06%), and for birth-related rectal injuries detected early, primary repair without diversion stoma may be the best treatment option.
mod_finding: The study specifically focused on isolated rectovaginal septum injuries occurring during spontaneous vaginal delivery, with all cases successfully managed by early transvaginal primary repair.
